'''Master Lerman''' is the chief mason for [[Elaida]]'s palace.
==Activities==
He is hired to build Elaida's palace, he is shocked to hear of the plans for a spire ten times higher than the [[White Tower]] itself, but he does not want to displease the [[Amyrlin Seat]].
